title: AHB Reset Sequence
description: Notice that HRESETn can assert asynchronously but must de-assert synchronously. HTRANS must be driven to IDLE.

annotations.message: Asynchronous assertion: HRESETn goes low in the middle of a cycle.
The master must immediately drive HTRANS to IDLE.
Synchronous de-assertion: HRESETn goes high aligned with the rising edge of HCLK.
The master can now safely drive a valid NONSEQ transfer.
